result.plainSummary: The navigation requirements point to checks for finding evidence and keeping approval problems visible.
result.summary: Reviewed W011 acceptance mapping to SL029 and b9215e80-1cbf-8bbf-83dc-63ceab15c182 navigation*.test.mjs. Both criteria concern one navigation composition; component interaction tests exercise legacy hashes, browser history and evidence visibility, while overview render checks retain permission, connection and attention states. Browser walkthrough remains required for three primary destinations, keyboard/narrow behavior and real evidence interaction; the command alone does not prove layout usability. Existing W010 saved-check tests preserve explicit execution behavior. The mapping is compatible with the preserved UI-only plan.
residualRisks: Component tests are complemented by the required live browser walkthrough; they do not establish mobile layout by themselves.
